# stockflow

Shared helpers used by the fulfilment, purchasing and finance teams to work with warehouse stock data: SKU and bin-location parsing, movement-record processing, on-hand and cycle-count reporting, inventory costing (FIFO, weighted average, freight allocation), replenishment planning and parcel building. Quantities are integer eaches, money is integer cents and dates are integer day indices, so every service computes the same numbers.

## Layout
- `src/stockflow/` - one module per function; each module is owned by one engineer (see CODEOWNERS)
- `tests/` - unit tests, maintained by the module owner
- `acceptance/` - acceptance checks maintained by QA; CI gates every ticket on them
- `docs/` - CI, release and contribution notes

## Sprint
This sprint finishes the open modules listed in the ticket board. Release cut: end of cycle 20.

# Handover notes (@yuki)

Notes I took over from the previous owner and from design reviews.

## weighted_average_cost (owner: @carla)
Agreed in design review: Rounding is half-up: an exact half cent goes up (100.5 -> 101), the same
way finance rounds on the stock ledger. Do not use round-half-to-even, and keep
the arithmetic in integers.

# Handover notes (@zoe)

Notes I took over from the previous owner and from design reviews.

## select_lots_fefo (owner: @ines)
Agreed in design review: expiry_day is the "best before" date printed on the case, and customers must
receive goods before that date, so a lot already counts as expired ON its
expiry_day: with min_shelf_days=0 a lot whose expiry_day == today is not
eligible. Expired therefore means expiry_day <= today.
files.notes/priya/handover.md:
# Handover notes (@priya)

Notes I took over from the previous owner and from design reviews.

## normalize_sku (owner: @nina)
Agreed in design review: Older shelf labels and supplier ASN files print SKUs without the hyphens,
e.g. "ABC1234561". That compact form must be accepted too and normalized to the
hyphenated form ("ABC-123456-1"). A code has either both hyphens or none; a code
with only one of the two hyphens is malformed.

# Handover notes (@felix)

## validate_transfer (owner: @david)
Agreed in design review: Movements are posted overnight: records dated on the transfer day itself are
not in the books yet and must not count toward the available stock. Only
movements with day < `day` count.

## replenishment_suggestions (owner: @aylin)
Agreed in design review: The EOQ is a floor, not a fixed amount: if inventory position + EOQ would
still be at or below the reorder point, order instead the smallest number of
whole packs (rounded UP, not with round_to_pack) that lifts the inventory
position above the reorder point.

## economic_order_quantity (owner: @luca)
Agreed in design review: Never suggest more than one year of demand: if the pack-rounded EOQ is larger
than annual_demand, return round_to_pack(annual_demand, pack_size) instead. This
matters for slow movers with high ordering costs.

## parse_location (owner: @felix)
Agreed in design review: Aisles and shelves are numbered from 01: "00" does not exist for either of
them and must be rejected with ValueError. Level 0 is valid (it is the floor
position under the first beam).

## pick_route_order (owner: @hugo)
Agreed in design review: Pickers walk the aisles in a serpentine (S-shaped) path: up the odd-numbered
aisles and back down the even-numbered ones. Shelves are therefore visited in
ascending order in odd aisles and in DESCENDING order in even aisles. Levels
within a shelf are always ascending.

## first_fit_decreasing (owner: @omar)

order. Packing must come out the same however the order lines happened to be
listed (the same order arrives sorted differently from the storefront and from
customer service).

## average_daily_demand (owner: @vera)
Agreed in design review: Demand is net of customer returns: RTN records of the SKU in the same day
range are subtracted from the shipped total before averaging. If returns exceed
shipments the demand is 0, never negative.

## safety_stock (owner: @malte)
Agreed in design review: The averages are used unrounded (exact fractions) and only the final result
is converted to whole units, always rounding UP: 16.25 units of safety stock
becomes 17. Planning never rounds a buffer down.

## cycle_count_variance (owner: @yuki)
Agreed in design review: A count covers the whole bin. If a location appears in `counts`, every system
position in that location whose SKU was not counted is treated as counted 0
(variance = -system qty). Locations that were not counted at all are ignored,
even if they hold stock.

## dead_stock (owner: @priya)
Agreed in design review: A SKU that has never shipped (as of today) is measured from its earliest
movement of any type instead, normally its first receipt: a product that
arrived last week is new, not dead.

## parse_movement_line (owner: @zoe)
Agreed in design review: Only ADJ records may carry a sign. RCV, SHP and RTN quantities must be
strictly positive as written; a zero or negative quantity on those types is a
data-entry error and raises ValueError (a negative SHP is NOT a return; returns
are booked as RTN). A zero ADJ is rejected as well.

## split_shipment (owner: @tobi)
Agreed in design review: Keep lines together when possible: a (merged) line whose total weight fits
within max_parcel_grams is packed as ONE item (weight qty x unit weight) and is
never split across parcels. Only lines heavier than the limit are broken into
single units. Customers kept complaining about getting one of two identical
items in a separate box.

## fifo_cogs (owner: @mara)
Agreed in design review: Units shipped beyond what the layers hold (the shortfall) are costed at the
unit cost of the most recent receipt: the layer with the latest receipt_day, or
the last such layer in list order if several share that day. The shortfall is
neither free nor an error; finance trues it up when the late receipt is booked.

## allocate_freight (owner: @ida)
Agreed in design review: When fractional remainders tie, the leftover cent goes to the line with the
larger value first (large lines absorb rounding with the smallest relative
error); only when the values are equal as well does the earlier line win.

## abc_classify (owner: @erik)
Agreed in design review: The SKU that crosses a threshold belongs to the higher class. A SKU is "A"
if the cumulative share BEFORE adding it is still below a_pct, and "B" if that
share is below b_pct. Example: values 50/40/10 give A, A, B (the second SKU takes
the running share from 50% to 90%, but it started below 80%).

## on_hand_by_location (owner: @pavel)
Agreed in design review: Positions that net to exactly zero are dropped from the result: an emptied
bin is not a stock position and must not show up on count sheets or transfer
screens. Negative totals are kept as they are (they flag a missed receipt and
must stay visible).
